Bulk Issue Mover

by Northgate Tooling Ltd — verified publisher

Move, re-key and re-parent issues across projects in bulk. Built for operations teams who do this every week and are tired of running a scripting console by hand. Works on projects of any size and keeps a full audit trail of every move so a mistake can be reversed.

What it does

Select a filter, preview every change, then apply. Nothing is written until the preview is confirmed. Failed moves are retried and reported, and the whole run can be exported as a CSV for the change record. Teams typically run this at the end of every sprint, which is why it is priced as a subscription rather than a one-off purchase.
